tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Fetch all available MagSnap photo magnet products, categories, pricing, and specs in South Africa (ZAR).

tools.name: calculate_quote
tools.description: Calculate an instant order quote for MagSnap photo magnets including item costs, AI 3D cartoon styling surcharge (+R5/ea), gift wrap (+R50), and courier delivery in South Africa.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Generate a pre-filled direct cart checkout link for magsnap.co.za so the customer can upload their photos and complete payment via PayFast.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Look up order status and shipping progress for an existing MagSnap order by Order ID.

tools.name: get_store_faq
tools.description: Retrieve official MagSnap product specifications, material durability, production turnaround, and courier delivery policies across South Africa.
